ActualTransport: IPv4 loopback TCP endpoints in one console process
Scope: Pure CLR protocol/session/world/fish-action fixtures plus host map-choice route slicing, canonical assembly, continuous IGP revisions and explicit retirement. Real IPv4 loopback TCP verifies preload transfer, scene preservation, replacement, fairness and source ownership. Four adapter fixtures compile the production MapChoiceController and observation DTO with only a logger stub; synthetic copied observations verify callback floors, no pre-route buffering, same-hash natural generations, truncated/read-error/null-group retirement, recovery and guest-local observer shutdown. Native hooks, native controller origin, cross-machine addresses, map adoption, AI isolation, effects, captures/rewards, normal return and two-game control remain unverified.
